#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

long long specialRow(long long m) {
    long long ans = 6 * (m / 6);
    long long mod = m % 6;
    if (mod == 5) return ans + 4;
    if (mod == 4) return ans + 2;
    return ans;
}

long long specialTwoRows(long long m) {
    if (m == 3) return 4;
    if (m == 7) return 12;
    if (m < 3) return 0;
    return 2 * m;
}

long long compute(long long n, long long m) {
    if (m < n) {
        long long temp = n;
        n = m;
        m = temp;
    }
    if (n == 1) return specialRow(m);
    if (n == 2) return specialTwoRows(m);
    return 2 * (n * m / 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cout << compute(n, m) << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
